items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: I remember I met him in Kansas City

ctx.x: Well, he said Frankie Trumbauer was his idol, the C-melody saxophone player.
Frankie Trumbauer was half of the saxophone players in the country in that day. Everybody learned how to play that one solo of Frank Trumbauer.
